setup_dataset_on_hub: create a dataset repository on the Hugging Face Hub using a repo ID and auth token
duplicate_space_on_hub: duplicate an existing Hugging Face space template to a new target repository with optional privacy settings
add_project_config_to_space_repo: add project configuration to space repositories linking the dataset, Argilla space, and project space
run_domain_data_grower_app: run the Streamlit Domain Data Grower app to set up domain-specific dataset project resources on the Hub
review_app_streamlit_ui: review the Streamlit UI configuration for the Domain Data Grower including page layout and input fields
